changelog.message: op created for standalone peer-to-peer WebRTC connection using shared folder signaling
changelog.author: Antigravity

changelog.message: simplified and made Webrtc op generic with raw SDP inputs and outputs and media streaming support
changelog.author: Antigravity

changelog.message: added remote video and audio output ports for displaying incoming streams
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Establishes a generic peer-to-peer WebRTC connection between two local/networked machines using raw SDP strings.

ports.name: Create Offer
ports.text: Initiator Only. Creates the PeerConnection, sets up data channel, handles media tracks, and generates local SDP offer.

ports.name: Remote SDP Input
ports.text: A multi-line string input port that accepts the raw configuration footprint (SDP JSON object or raw text) from the remote machine.

ports.name: Set Remote SDP
ports.text: Executes the handshake loop by parsing the Remote SDP Input string. Creates the answer if an offer is received, or finalizes connection if an answer is received.

ports.name: Send Data
ports.text: Trigger to send the data payload over the established data channel.

ports.name: Data to Send
ports.text: The string message or JSON action map payload to transmit.

ports.name: Target Canvas Object
ports.text: Optional. Accepts a canvas reference from a RenderTarget or HTML canvas to capture and stream WebGL frame streams.

ports.name: Target Audio Stream
ports.text: Optional. Accepts a Web Audio API MediaStream object to stream audio frames.

ports.name: Local SDP Output
ports.text: The local connection string profile (SDP JSON object) generated by the local machine.

ports.name: On SDP Generated
ports.text: Fires when the local SDP configuration finishes compiling and is written to the Local SDP Output port.

ports.name: Channel Status
ports.text: Displays the WebRTC connection status: Disconnected, Connecting, Open, or Closed.

ports.name: On Data Received
ports.text: Fires whenever a data channel payload block is received.

ports.name: Received Data
ports.text: Displays the raw payload string delivered by the remote peer.

ports.name: Has Audio
ports.text: True if the processed SDP strings contain active audio configuration segments.

ports.name: Has Video
ports.text: True if the processed SDP strings contain active video configuration segments.

ports.name: Has Data
ports.text: True if the processed SDP strings contain an active data channel protocol payload.

ports.name: Remote Video Element
ports.text: Exposes an HTML <video> element playing the incoming remote stream. Connect to a VideoTexture operator to render.

ports.name: Remote Audio Stream
ports.text: Exposes the raw incoming remote MediaStream containing audio tracks for audio playback or custom node routing.
